item.name: List the APIs published by a provider.

description.content: Returns a page of the APIs owned by one provider, optionally filtered by tags and required artifact types. Pass `include=content` to inline artifact bodies.

query.description: Comma-separated tags to filter by. Tag names are Title Case (e.g. Messaging); lowercase slugs (e.g. messaging) are also accepted.
Whether results must match `any` (default) or `all` of the supplied tags.
Comma-separated artifact types. Filters which artifacts are returned and (on list endpoints) which APIs qualify.
Extra data to embed. `content` fetches and inlines artifact bodies.
Sparse fieldset — comma-separated property names to return.
1-based page number.
Items per page.

item.name: List and filter APIs across the network.

request.name: List and filter APIs across the network.

description.content:
The core cross-provider discovery endpoint. Filter by free text, one or many tags
(`match=any|all`), one or many providers, and/or the artifact types an API must
publish. Use `artifact_types` together with `fields=...,properties` to return only
the artifacts you want.

query.description: Free-text query over name and description (and tags where applicable).
Comma-separated tags to filter by. Tag names are Title Case (e.g. Messaging); lowercase slugs (e.g. messaging) are also accepted.
Whether results must match `any` (default) or `all` of the supplied tags.
Comma-separated provider slugs to scope results to.
Comma-separated artifact types. Filters which artifacts are returned and (on list endpoints) which APIs qualify.
Filter by one or more industry slugs.
Filter by one or more region slugs.
Extra data to embed. `content` fetches and inlines artifact bodies.
Filter by one or more rating bands.
Minimum composite score (0–100).
Sparse fieldset — comma-separated property names to return.
1-based page number.
Items per page.
